name: io.github.De-Ioannidis/carmaker-mcp
title: CarMaker
description: Drive IPG CarMaker for Simulink: run test runs, read results, edit vehicle data and parameters.

runtimeArguments.name: --python
runtimeArguments.description: A Python version your CarMaker install ships its Python API for (CarMaker 14.1: 3.10 to 3.12).

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: MATLAB Engine for Python matching your MATLAB release. `carmaker-mcp doctor` prints the right value.

environmentVariables.name: CM_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: CarMaker project folder. All writes are confined to it.

environmentVariables.name: CM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Simulink model that cm_session_start opens (name on the MATLAB path, or a file).

environmentVariables.name: CM_MATLAB_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Name under which MATLAB shares its engine.

environmentVariables.name: CM_POPUP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds after which CarMaker GUI pop-ups answer themselves with their default choice. Not set: they wait for a click.

environmentVariables.name: CM_ENABLE
environmentVariables.description: Optional tools, comma separated: tcl (raw Tcl in the GUI), experimental (Simulink structure edits).

environmentVariables.name: CM_DISABLE
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to switch off, comma separated: standalone, study, matlab.
